description: Default capability for compact widget + main dashboard webviews. Grants core IPC permissions used by tauri-plugin-updater + TauRPC handlers (cross-cutting envelope: health, app_info, ready, get_settings, update_settings per arch §Standard Contracts). Per-procedure granularity is not enforced at capability level — TauRPC dispatches all router methods through a single invoke handler; xtask capability-drift gate (route#22) introspects the router and asserts router-level coverage. Per chunk #47 also covers plugins.{list,reload,invoke} (router-level coverage per CLAUDE.md Session Additions 2026-05-03 TauRPC capability rule). Per chunk #49 also covers mcp.{status,start,stop} (sidecar lifecycle gated by --features mcp-server build + ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MCP_ENABLED runtime env var; double-gate re-validated at IPC entry per security plan §Anti-Patterns Code Patterns row 3). Per chunk #68 also covers storage.{inspect,path} (persistent incident corpus introspection — read-only-by-design per capability P-051; deletion is a separate procedure with explicit confirmation deferred to follow-up chunk). Per chunk #69 Phase B also covers diagnostics.template_distribution (Drain log-template-mining profiling — read-only-by-design; in-memory template tree query for the Settings → Diagnostics panel). Per chunk #78 also covers incidents.{list_active,acknowledge,mark_resolved} (corpus-backed Active/Resolved lifecycle persistence + acknowledge cool-down 5-min per kind-and-scope + workspace attribution + P-045 counter derivation; auto-resolution at 120s no-reemission per capability P-022; broadcast topic pulse://stream/incidents emits bounded lifecycle events Created/Updated/Resolved/Acknowledged). Per chunk #82 also covers model.current_profile (L4 LLM interpretation pipeline — hardware profile + model tier + load status + semantic model identity; backed by interpretation::contract::LlmInferenceRunner trait and concrete MistralRsInference stub returning ModelStatus::Error until ANDROMEDA_PULSE_MODEL_PATH is configured per capabilities P-053/P-054). Per chunk #86 also covers diagnostics.retry_interpretation (manual L4 interpretation retry override during exponential backoff cool-down per capability P-020 graceful degradation reaching full; backoff progression 2→5→10 min capped resets immediately on successful parse OR manual retry; resolution summaries attach к incident BLOB without surface notification per capabilities P-022 + P-059). Per chunk #87 also covers incidents.mark_all_read (Findings counter + dropdown bulk-mark-as-read action — workspace-scoped, sets read_at_unix_nano on all unread Active / Acknowledged incidents in the current workspace, persist failures non-fatal, single aggregate incident.broadcast.bulk_acknowledged tracing event per invocation preserving cardinality discipline per CLAUDE.md observability 2026-05-17 session 84; capabilities P-028 Findings Counter + P-029 Findings Dropdown + P-030 No Interrupting Notifications).
